tools.name: get_my_account
tools.description: The Superstables account connected to this chat: id, nullable name, active wallets (oldest first), client_name, registration and scopes. address and namespace identify the first wallet, or are both null if none. Namespace is eip155 for Ethereum or solana for Solana. Moves no funds.

tools.name: find_services
tools.description: Search the services this chat can buy through Superstables: each one's id, what it returns, its price in a test token, the chain it is paid on and its inputs. q matches words in the id, name and description; chain matches a chain's id or name. Reads a public catalogue and moves no funds.

tools.name: request_purchase
tools.description: Requests approval to buy one service from find_services. Returns an approval link and match code. Any account member may review and sign the payment in a wallet on superstables.com; nothing is paid until then. Use a new operation_id for each purchase. tools.name: get_purchase_status
tools.description: Reads a purchase this chat asked for: whether the owner approved it, whether it was paid, the service's answer and the receipt. Show the owner the approval link and match code before calling this tool. Then keep calling it with wait_seconds 25 in the same turn while the result says to keep waiting.

tools.name: list_my_budgets
tools.description: The agents linked to this Superstables account and their budgets: each agent's id, label, chain, budget, what is left to spend, what it has used (null when not counted), its gas balance and the state of its budget. Reads the chain now and moves no funds.

tools.name: get_budget_request
tools.description: Reads one budget approval from the approval link the Superstables CLI printed: its kind, state, whether it is final, its steps and their transaction hashes. Pass the whole link. It doesn't return the link's token and moves no funds.

tools.name: request_budget_revoke
tools.description: Gives the owner the link to revoke an agent's budget, for an agent from list_my_budgets. The owner signs the revoke with their wallet on superstables.com. This tool signs and sends nothing and does not revoke the budget.

tools.name: remove_budget_agent
tools.description: Removes an agent from this account, off chain, once Superstables confirms it has no spending permission. A live Tempo key must be revoked even if its current budget is spent. Moves no funds.

tools.name: submit_budget_request
tools.description: Only for a coding agent on the owner's machine, such as Claude Code or Codex, sending a block that its own Superstables CLI signed and whose agent key and records stay on that machine. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_purchase_status" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Reads a purchase this chat asked for: whether the owner approved it, whether it was paid, the service's answer and the receipt. Show the owner the approval link…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.superstables.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_my_account, find_services, get_purchase_status, find_budget_services · Private data: get_my_account, find_services, request_purchase, get_budget_request, request_budget_revoke, submit_budget_request, preflight_budget_purchase, get_budget_status · Public sink: submit_budget_request · Destructive: remove_budget_agent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_my_account, find_services, get_purchase_status, find_budget_services · Private data: get_my_account, find_services, request_purchase, get_budget_request, request_budget_revoke, submit_budget_request, preflight_budget_purchase, get_budget_status · Public sink: submit_budget_request · Destructive: remove_budget_agent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
